items.title: GTA 6 Softlock Bug Keeps You From Finishing the Main Story
items.summary: Some players get stuck at roughly 72% story completion when Raul never calls Lucia in the mission Raul's Plan, and the article describes a workaround that involves Valentina's call.

items.title: Union Vote Fails In Landslide At GTA 6 Studio Rockstar Games As 75 Percent Of Devs Vote No
items.summary: UK Rockstar developers voted about 75% against a union recognition deal with the IWGB, and Rockstar's head of publishing said the result reflects staff support for direct collaboration.

items.title: GTA 6: All Secret Radio Stations and how to unlock them
items.summary: A guide to unlocking The Vault and Kodak Black's The Sniper of LaPerle radio stations by scanning posters around Vice City.

items.title: GTA 6 Secret Mission in Capri: How to Find and Complete the Hidden Mission
items.summary: A walkthrough of a hidden Capri mission that starts when you get arrested and ends with you escaping a police holding facility and getting the CPD Moreland 850 shotgun.

items.title: GTA 6 PC Port Already Runs at 24 FPS, Uses 10 GB of RAM
items.summary: An unofficial PC build is reportedly reaching 24 FPS in gameplay on 10 GB of RAM, even as Take-Two issues DMCA takedowns against recompilation projects.

items.title: How to get abducted and find aliens in GTA 6
items.summary: GamesRadar's guide covers triggering the abduction, the dream puzzle and keypad code, and rescuing the alien for permanent health, stamina and focus boosts.

items.title: This website has GTA 6 fans queuing for hours to take over a stranger's PS5 and play for free
items.summary: A site called PlayMyPS5 lets visitors queue for five-minute remote sessions on a shared PS5 so the community can try to finish every story mission.

items.title: GTA 6 Is Selling Out PS5 Consoles, but Sony's Black Friday Plans Make It Even Worse
items.summary: PS5 consoles have sold out at major US retailers less than a week after GTA 6 launched, and Sony has no Black Friday discounts planned.

items.title: Attempts To Vibe-Code PC Ports Of GTA 6 Are Being Shut Down, But It Might Be Too Late To Put The Genie Back In The Bottle
items.summary: Take-Two's takedown request led GitHub to remove all 3,007 Project Leonida repositories, while other AI-assisted PC port attempts continue.

items.title: GTA 6 Is Reportedly Frying Some PS5 Consoles
items.summary: Streamers and Reddit users report crashes and even smoking PS5s while playing GTA 6.
